Linked issue text:
Issue #1442:
*Please describe the problem or feature*

Would flake8 consider a PR to add ".nox" to the default exclude list?  Nox is similar to and inspired by tox, but uses a Python file to create and manage the sessions.

https://nox.thea.codes/en/stable/index.html


PR title:
Add .nox to default exclude list

PR body:
I think this is everywhere that it should be added to, docs and `defaults.py`.

Closes #1442

--- src/flake8/defaults.py ---
"""Constants that define defaults."""
import re

EXCLUDE = (
    ".svn",
    "CVS",
    ".bzr",
    ".hg",
    ".git",
    "__pycache__",
    ".tox",
    ".eggs",
    "*.egg",
)
IGNORE = ("E121", "E123", "E126", "E226", "E24", "E704", "W503", "W504")
SELECT = ("E", "F", "W", "C90")
MAX_LINE_LENGTH = 79
INDENT_SIZE = 4

TRUTHY_VALUES = {"true", "1", "t"}

# Other constants
WHITESPACE = frozenset(" \t")

STATISTIC_NAMES = ("logical lines", "physical lines", "tokens")

NOQA_INLINE_REGEXP = re.compile(
    # We're looking for items that look like this:
    # ``# noqa``
    # ``# noqa: E123``
    # ``# noqa: E123,W451,F921``
    # ``# noqa:E123,W451,F921``
    # ``# NoQA: E123,W451,F921``
    # ``# NOQA: E123,W451,F921``
    # ``# NOQA:E123,W451,F921``
    # We do not want to capture the ``: `` that follows ``noqa``
    # We do not care about the casing of ``noqa``
    # We want a comma-separated list of errors
    # https://regex101.com/r/4XUuax/2 full explanation of the regex
    r"# noqa(?::[\s]?(?P<codes>([A-Z]+[0-9]+(?:[,\s]+)?)+))?",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

NOQA_FILE = re.compile(r"\s*# flake8[:=]\s*noqa", re.I)

{
  "path": "tests/test_default_exclude.py",
  "content": "import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import os


def test_default_exclude_includes_nox():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
        nox_dir = os.path.join(tmpdir, ".nox")
        os.makedirs(nox_dir)
        pyfile = os.path.join(nox_dir, "test.py")
        with open(pyfile, "w") as f:
            f.write("x = 1\n")
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "flake8", "--exclude", "", tmpdir],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
        )
        assert result.returncode == 0, f"Expected no errors, got: {result.stdout}"
"
}
